fields.statement: At 6f24552b ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-start-milestone-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous-left|arbiter-agent-tabs|describe-golden)$': all PASS; go vet ./internal/api clean. run-start-milestone-autonomous shows run start --workflow plan --autonomous with --new --milestone and on a record change set each exits 2 with 'milestone planning needs the owner', leaving the change set count unchanged and no .git/rhiza/runs; the same record start without --autonomous succeeds, an --new intention with --autonomous succeeds with autonomous true, and run resume of the record run's journal edited to autonomous exits 2 with the same error. plan-workflow-autonomous and -left now start --new intention runs (intent without milestone=1 under a landed ms milestone; -left's keep-flat Decision landed with --record before the run) and still check the arbiter's answers, review rounds, the check's questions in the draft and the gate accepting with rule autonomous.
